intro: The landmarks that mark Ze's path from a bare BGP speaker to a full network operating system. Each entry is the first time a whole capability arrived; the week-by-week detail lives in the Changes log and the blog. Newest first, color-coded by category.

milestones.title: BGP engine
milestones.blurb: The foundational BGP speaker lands: wire-format codec, every message type, capability negotiation, path attributes, a RIB, and the finite state machine, tested against ExaBGP from day one.

milestones.title: Config model and CLI editor
milestones.blurb: A schema-driven configuration parser with ExaBGP-compatible syntax, wired straight to the reactor, plus an interactive CLI editor with autocomplete.

milestones.title: ExaBGP migration path
milestones.blurb: `exabgp migrate` converts ExaBGP configs to Ze's format, and a bridge runs existing ExaBGP process plugins under Ze, translating JSON and commands both ways.

milestones.title: Hub architecture and Plugin SDK
milestones.blurb: Ze splits into a hub orchestrator that forks BGP as a child process, gains live config reload over SIGHUP, and ships a documented SDK for writing plugins outside the core tree.

milestones.title: BGP Route Server
milestones.blurb: A forward-all Route Server (RFC 7947) for IXPs: targeted per-peer replay on reconnect, backpressure-safe forwarding, and plugin dependency resolution.

milestones.title: Best-path selection
milestones.blurb: On-demand best-path selection in the RIB, covering LOCAL_PREF, AS_PATH length, ORIGIN, MED, eBGP/iBGP preference, and the full tiebreak chain (RFC 4271 section 9.1.2).

milestones.title: SSH CLI, TCP-MD5, and RBAC
milestones.blurb: An SSH server becomes the primary way to reach the CLI, alongside TCP-MD5 session authentication (RFC 2385) and end-to-end RBAC authorization.

milestones.title: RPKI origin validation
milestones.blurb: A full RPKI pipeline: an RTR-speaking plugin maintains a ROA cache and validates route origins as routes arrive on the adjacency RIB-in path, not after the fact.

milestones.title: Web interface
milestones.blurb: A browser-based config editor with YANG-driven rendering, per-user drafts, inline diffs, live SSE updates, and a light/dark theme, started with `ze start --web`.

milestones.title: MCP server for AI operations
milestones.blurb: An MCP server exposing tools for AI-assisted BGP operations: announce, withdraw, peer status, peer control, and command execution.

milestones.title: Interfaces and kernel FIB
milestones.blurb: A JunOS-style interface management subsystem (netlink monitoring, DHCP, SLAAC) and a FIB pipeline that installs best-path routes into the kernel via netlink.

milestones.title: BFD liveness detection
milestones.blurb: A complete BFD implementation (RFC 5880/5881/5883): single- and multi-hop, authentication, echo mode, BGP session opt-in, and operator visibility.

milestones.title: gokrazy appliance build
milestones.blurb: The first gokrazy VM appliance build for x86_64: the start of Ze shipping as a self-contained appliance image, not just a daemon.

milestones.title: L2TP/PPP broadband access
milestones.blurb: A full L2TPv2 stack for broadband access: tunnel and session FSMs, a reliable delivery engine, and PPP authentication (PAP, CHAP-MD5, MS-CHAPv2).

milestones.title: VPP dataplane
milestones.blurb: A VPP dataplane backend for high-performance forwarding: connection management, DPDK binding, and FIB programming via GoVPP.

milestones.title: Firewall and traffic control
milestones.blurb: nftables and tc-netlink backends sharing one YANG data model, with `show firewall` and `show traffic-control` commands.

milestones.title: Appliance fleet management
milestones.blurb: `ze appliance` manages images end to end: encrypted secrets, TLS and SSH provisioning, day-2 operations, remote push, and export/import for disaster recovery.

milestones.title: IPsec / IKEv2 VPN
milestones.blurb: A native IKEv2 VPN stack built from the wire format up and interop-tested against strongSwan: child SA negotiation, EAP, NAT-T, and route-based VPN via XFRM.

milestones.title: MPLS label switching
milestones.blurb: Label switching across three layers, verified in QEMU against FRR: a kernel MPLS dataplane, LDP (RFC 5036), and RSVP-TE.

milestones.title: Native IS-IS
milestones.blurb: A native IS-IS link-state IGP (ISO/IEC 10589, RFC 1195): full PDU/TLV codec, adjacency FSM, LSDB flooding, DIS election, and SPF with ECMP, interop-tested against FRR's isisd.

milestones.title: OSPFv2 / OSPFv3
milestones.blurb: A unified OSPFv2/OSPFv3 engine with IPv6 interop coverage and live SSE state views in the web UI.

milestones.title: DDoS auto-mitigation
milestones.blurb: Control-plane survival under attack: GTSM/TTL-security (RFC 5082), CoPP policing on TCP/179, and automatic DDoS detection with attack-characterized auto-mitigation.

milestones.title: VRRP first-hop redundancy
milestones.blurb: First-hop gateway redundancy with RFC 9568 VRRPv3 (IPv4 and IPv6) and RFC 3768 VRRPv2, a per-group virtual-MAC macvlan for transparent L2 failover, and keepalived interop under QEMU.
